standaloneTable.comment: Toolbar notification icon configuration — icons displayed in the PowerSchool header toolbar, each with icon name, URL, SQL query for badge count, sort order, and disabled toggle.

field.name: id
field.comment: Unique business key (e.g., 'messages', 'alerts') used by the toolbar to identify this icon

field.name: icon
field.comment: PDS-style icon name matching the map in src/lib/icons.ts (e.g., 'mail', 'bell', 'star')

field.name: href
field.comment: Link target URL when the icon is clicked (e.g., /admin/messages.html)

field.name: title
field.comment: Display name shown in the icon fallback initial letter

field.name: description
field.comment: Hover tooltip text — shown when user hovers over the icon (e.g., 'View your school messages')

field.name: count_sql
field.comment: SQL query that returns the badge count. Use ~(curuserid) for user-scoped queries. Must return a single numeric value.

field.name: sort_order
field.comment: Display order in the toolbar (lower = first)

field.name: disabled
field.comment: Set to '1' to hide this icon from the toolbar
